1348.1001.1.description:
Tacacs+ user login, server online

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies TACACS+ login authentication with the server online, confirming valid TACACS+ users are admitted and invalid ones rejected.

1348.1001.2.description:
Tacacs+ user login with server offline

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies login behaviour when the TACACS+ server is offline, confirming the configured fallback (local) authentication path is used.

1348.1001.4.description:
Tacacs+ CLI commands

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the TACACS+ server configuration CLI commands are accepted and reflected in running-config.

1348.1001.5.description:
SSH login from tb

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an authorized user with a generated user key can SSH into the device from the test box.

1348.1001.6.description:
SSH deny certain users

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that SSH access can be denied to specific users via the SSH allow/deny user lists.

1348.1001.7.description:
SSH check CLI commands

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the SSH server configuration CLI commands behave correctly and are reflected in running-config.

1348.1001.8.description:
SSH concurrent users login from tb

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an authorized user with a generated user key can SSH into the device from the test box.

1348.1001.9.description:
Radius server online: various users logging in

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies RADIUS login authentication with the server online, confirming valid RADIUS users are admitted while invalid and locally-only users are rejected.

1348.1001.10.description:
Radius CLI commands

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the RADIUS server configuration CLI commands are accepted and reflected in running-config.

1348.1001.11.description:
802.1x configuration changes

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies 802.1X port-based authentication configuration, confirming dot1x is enabled and the correct RADIUS server is referenced, and that config is restored after the test.

1348.1001.12.description:
User login to local radius-server on a vlan

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies login authentication against the on-box local RADIUS server reachable over a VLAN interface, confirming valid users are admitted.

1348.1001.13.description:
Local radius-server CLI commands

1348.1001.14.description:
Radius server accounting logins

1348.1001.15.description:
Tacacs+ accounting server login

1348.1001.16.description:
Tacacs+ accounting server commands

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies TACACS+ command accounting, confirming executed CLI commands are recorded as accounting records on the TACACS+ server.

1348.1001.17.description:
SSH scp copy

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies SCP file copy over SSH, confirming files can be securely transferred to the device.

1348.1001.18.description:
SSH sftp copy

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies SFTP file transfer over SSH, confirming files can be securely transferred with the device.

1348.1001.19.description:
Auth-mac authentication on port

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies MAC-based (auth-mac) port authentication, confirming a supplicant's MAC is authenticated against RADIUS before network access is granted.

1348.1001.20.description:
802.1x/ dot1x authentication on port

1348.1001.22.description:
SSH scp copy from dut

1348.1001.35.description:
Auth-mac with auth-forward, all forwards
